description.value: The Shuswap Pie Company is a beloved scratch bakery and café in Salmon Arm known for handcrafted savory and sweet pies made in small batches with local, preservative-free ingredients. Cyclists can drop in for a full lunch — soups, grilled paninis, and a rotating monthly hot special — or grab a fresh-baked pie and coffee to go. The shop has earned regional press coverage and a loyal local following for the quality and integrity of its all-natural baking.

address.value: 331a Alexander NE, Salmon Arm, British Columbia

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the business is an active scratch bakery and café in Salmon Arm, with contact details (address: 331a Alexander NE, Salmon Arm, BC; phone: 250-832-7992) visible across multiple pages.
